pair.title: Pair this device
pair.intro: This screen is used as a scanning station. Enter the 8-character pairing code from PantryNanny (Settings › Devices), or sign in.
pair.error: The code was not accepted. Check it (valid for 15 minutes) and try again.
pair.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

start.title: Ready to scan
start.hint: Tap once to enable the camera and sound. After that you should not need to touch the screen.
start.offlineReady: Offline: scans are saved and uploaded when the connection returns.
start.dropped: {{count}} unsynced scans from another household were discarded.

last.empty: Hold a barcode in front of the camera
last.unknownBackground: Unknown – being looked up in the background

toast.unknown: Unknown item saved – can be named later
toast.saveFailed: COULD NOT SAVE scan ({{code}}) – scan again

denied.title: Camera is blocked
denied.body: Allow camera access for PantryNanny in Safari: Settings › Safari › Camera › Ask/Allow, or tap aA in the address bar › Website Settings › Camera › Allow. If the app is on the Home Screen you may need to delete and re-add it. You can still use manual entry.

notfound.title: No camera found
notfound.body: This device has no usable camera. Use manual entry.

busy.title: Camera is in use
busy.body: Another app is using the camera. Close it and try again.

insecure.title: Requires HTTPS
insecure.body: The camera only works over a secure (HTTPS) connection.

other.title: Camera could not start
other.body: Try again or reload the page.

wake.unsupported: The screen may go to sleep. Set Auto-Lock to Never in Settings › Display & Brightness and use Guided Access.
wake.failed: Could not keep the screen awake. Set Auto-Lock to Never.

failed.banner: {{count}} change(s) were rejected by the server
failed.title: Rejected changes

hid.hint: Scan with a Bluetooth or USB barcode scanner. The camera is off; turn it on with the camera button.

session.title: Scan session
session.pending: {{count}} change(s) still waiting to sync – they upload automatically.
